CLI.md:72:Folder spaces are served by SilverBullet Desktop. Without it installed, file commands (`fs`), runtime commands, and creating, adding, renaming, moving or relocating a folder space all fail with an error saying Desktop is required. `sb space list` and `sb space remove` still work, so entries left by an uninstalled Desktop can be cleaned up. Remote spaces don’t need Desktop.
CLI.md:115:List, read, create, edit, and delete files in a remote space using its existing HTTP filesystem API. Select a connection with the usual `--space`, `--url`, and `--token` flags. Paths are space-relative filenames, including `.md`. Quote paths containing spaces and use `/` between directories. Patch input, recursive deletion, copy, and move are not supported. To search page content, use [[#`search <text>`|`sb search`]].
